theFootprintCarry.rootCause: a footprint cell has no independent source: it is area x coverage. theFootprintCarry.decision: a footprint whose recorded coverage input still equals the pinned coverage CARRIES its stored value -- citation and dates move, the number does not. When the recorded coverage input HAS moved, the footprint IS re-derived from the recorded area and that move is reported as a value change like any other. theFootprintCarry.whyThisIsDisclosedSoLoudly: it is the one substantive divergence from a literal re-derivation, and the honest alternative was to ship 21,437 customer-visible +/-0.01 sq ft moves with no law behind them. findingsAndLessons.LESSON: A pre-registration computed over the population YOUR OWN READ CAN SEE is not the population the job will run over. This lane's first prediction was right about every release number and structurally blind to the left-alone arms, because a parcel already at the pin carries no stale cell to find it by -- and 48209 had 52,064 such cells. Writing the second pre-registration before the runs (rather than explaining the number after them) is what makes 'the at-pin arm is exactly 52,064' evidence instead of a coincidence.
findingsAndLessons.LESSON-2: Re-derivation from a ROUNDED recorded input is not the same as re-derivation from the original measurement. The footprint cell records parcelAreaSqFt rounded to 2dp, so a 'citation refresh' would have moved 21,437 customer-visible numbers by exactly +/-0.01 with no change in the law -- found only because the dispatch pre-registered '0 value changes' and the first prediction disagreed. The dispatch's own prediction is what made this visible.

findingsAndLessons.DEAD-END: Do NOT plan on running the job's own dry run without the cortex heavy-scan lease: the job takes it unconditionally (grantHeavyScanLease is called before the run row, dry run or not), refuses with LEASE_HELD and records a refusal row. The cortex slot was held by other seats for the first ~40 minutes of this lane's dry-run step. Read heavy_scan_lease_live and sleep to the holder's expiry; do not retry the grant.
findingsAndLessons.DEAD-END-2: Do NOT cite a scratch .err file as evidence of a lease refusal: the successful re-run truncates it. The durable record is the heavy_scan_lease_refusals row, which is why CP1's pointer to the file was corrected to the table.
findingsAndLessons.OPEN: The at-pin population in 48209 (Kyle 44,498 cells, Dripping Springs 7,560, San Marcos 6) shows an EARLIER partial run of this job wrote those cities at 1.4.0 while the six counties' other cities still sit at 1.1.0. findingsAndLessons.OPEN-2: 13 of the 14 jurisdiction keys the release re-resolves carry NO readable effective date at the pin, so 707,214 released cells will carry dateBasis 'unreadable' after the apply. That is a corpus-coverage fact for the setback-corpus owners, not a defect in this release.
